## Notes on DepthAnyEvent
- Tencode with blackframe gave better results
- DAE using the DAv2's infer_image() function gave better results than simpel torch interpolate().
- DAv2's infer_image contains ImageNet normalization, but I don't know whether this is useful for tencode.
